descGu: Steps ક્રમ માં! Robot ઠીક આ રીતે think કરે.
descEn: Steps in order — how every robot thinks!
descDa: Trin for trin — præcis som en robot tænker!

teacherGuide.conceptGu: Algorithm = exact steps in order. Sequence + loop + condition = every program. Order ખોટો = crash!
teacherGuide.conceptEn: Algorithm = exact steps in order. Sequence + loop + condition = every program. Wrong order = crash!
teacherGuide.conceptDa: En algoritme er præcise trin i rækkefølge. Forkert rækkefølge = fejl!
teacherGuide.storyGu: 'Pizza recipe ઉલટી — cheese first, dough after = disaster! Computer algorithm ઉલટો = crash!'
teacherGuide.storyEn: 'Pizza recipe backwards — cheese first, dough after = disaster! Computer algorithm backwards = crash!'
teacherGuide.storyDa: 'Pizzarækkefølge baglæns — ost først, dej bagefter = katastrofe! En algoritme skal følge rækkefølgen!'
teacherGuide.scriptGu: 'Minecraft house: floor → walls → roof → door. ઉલટું — roof without walls impossible!'
teacherGuide.scriptEn: 'Minecraft house: floor → walls → roof → door. Reverse — roof without walls impossible!'
teacherGuide.scriptDa: 'Minecraft-hus: gulv → vægge → tag → dør. Tag uden vægge er umuligt!'
teacherGuide.tipsGu: 💡 Morning routine draw — wake→brush→eat→school. Mix up for fun — 'School first?!' 😂
teacherGuide.tipsEn: 💡 Draw a morning routine. Mix up the order for fun — 'School before waking up?!' 😂
teacherGuide.tipsDa: 💡 Tegn en morgenrutine. Byt rundt på rækkefølgen for sjov — 'Skole før man vågner?!' 😂

questions.hintEn: Bread first, then filling, then top, then eat!
questions.hintDa: Brød først, så fyld, så top, så spis!

questions.hintEn: Scan first, then find, clean, go home!
questions.hintDa: Scan først, så find, gør rent, gå hjem!

questions.textGu: Robot obstacle જુએ. IF obstacle THEN ___?
questions.textDa: Robot ser en forhindring. HVIS forhindring SÅ ___?
questions.hintGu: IF obstacle THEN stop and turn!
questions.hintEn: Stop and turn to avoid it!
questions.hintDa: Stop og drej for at undgå den!

questions.textGu: Robot 5 rooms clean. Same steps 5 times = ___
questions.hintEn: A loop repeats the same steps!
questions.hintDa: Et loop gentager de samme trin!
